# pantechdynamics_container_repository (Resource)

A repository in your organization's container registry namespace (pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace), such as acme/api/server. Push to it with docker push <full_name>:<tag> after docker login. **Destroying it deletes every image in it.** At most 100 repositories per organization; only an API key made by an owner or admin can change them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace" "main" {
  name = "acme"
}

# A private repository whose release tags can never be moved, keeping the 50
# newest tags (and every v* tag) and removing untagged images after a week.
# Destroying it deletes every image in it.
resource "pantechdynamics_container_repository" "api" {
  name           = "api/server"
  description    = "API server images"
  immutable_tags = true

  retention = {
    keep_last           = 50
    untagged_after_days = 7
    keep_pattern        = "v*"
  }

  # The repository needs the namespace, which no attribute references.
  depends_on = [pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace.main]
}

# Push with: docker push <full_name>:<tag>
output "api_image" {
  value = pantechdynamics_container_repository.api.full_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name inside the namespace, such as "api/server": lower-case path components of letters and digits, with single ".", "_" or "-" between them, at most 255 characters. Changing it replaces the repository, and deletes its images.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A note for yourself, at most 255 characters. Defaults to "".
- `immutable_tags` (Boolean) When true, a tag once pushed cannot be moved to another image or deleted; a push that moves one is reverted. Defaults to false.
- `retention` (Attributes) Automatic cleanup, run daily. Leave it out for none; set at least one rule inside it. Tags matching keep_pattern are never removed by it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `visibility` (String) "private" (only your organization and its registry tokens can pull) or "public" (anyone can pull, without logging in). Defaults to "private".

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the repository was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `full_name` (String) The image name to tag and push, such as "registry.pantechdynamics.com/acme/api/server".
- `id` (String) Identifier of the repository, starting with crr_.
- `last_pushed_at` (String) When an image was last pushed, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second. Null until the first push.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace the repository is in.
- `status` (String) "active", "deleting" or "suspended" (an operator suspended it; it cannot change).
- `storage_bytes` (Number) Storage the repository's images use, in bytes.
- `tag_count` (Number) How many tags the repository holds.

<a id="nestedatt--retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention`

Optional:

- `keep_last` (Number) Keep only the newest this many tags, 1 to 1000.
- `keep_pattern` (String) A glob such as "v*" or "release-*", at most 128 characters: matching tags are always kept.
- `untagged_after_days` (Number) Delete untagged images older than this many days, 1 to 365.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A repository is imported by its id, or by its name in the namespace.
terraform import pantechdynamics_container_repository.api crr_06ggf5abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
terraform import pantechdynamics_container_repository.api api/server
```
